messages:
Iris: Tiny holiday plan  plant adoption corner? People can take a small desk plant for the season and leave a tiny ornament. :seedling:
Noel: Love this. I have 6 succulents that could use new desks. Can we add a 'return by Feb' sticker for borrowed plants?
Hana: I'll make little name-tags with watering notes. Mini ornaments yes but please no glitter (too messy).
Kai: Remote folks can request a "plant-swap care card" and we'll match them with an in-office buddy to look after it.
GreenThumb Bot: Tip: Succulents prefer bright, indirect light; water sparingly in winter (every ~2 weeks).
Marta: I'll bring small burlap pots and ornament clips. Also, can we do a micro "naming" ritual where people write a name on the tag?
Iris: Naming ritual = approved. Quick 5-min drop-in at 3:45 to place plants and names on the table.
Noel: Quick poll  react :seedling: if you'll adopt, :recycle: if you'll leave a plant, :x: if you're out.
Kai: Also idea  "plant postcards": leave a 1-line story or pun on a card about your plant. Remote folks can DM and we'll print.
Hana: I'll set up a small station with labels, scissors, and gloves.
DevBot: Reminder scheduled: Today 15:30 - Plant corner set up.
Marta: Consent check for photos  thumbs-up here if it's okay to share plant corner pics in #random slideshow.
Iris: thumbs up
Noel: thumbs up :thumbsup:
Kai: thumbs up
GreenThumb Bot: Safety note: avoid placing plants on top of radiators or in cold-draft spots below 45F overnight.
Hana: I'll draft a tiny care card to include with each plant (light, water, tip).
Marta: Bonus: funniest plant pun on a tag wins a sticker pack. Start practicing your puns now.
Iris: Perfect. Tiny green takeover incoming  excited for the plant cheer and puns :herb:
